messages.en:
{07 16 00}The other day I got a
letter from {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}.

{07 0f 00}But I totally forgot to mail
my reply. {01 01 00}{07 06 00}Oh!{01 01 00} {07 0b 00}Could I get
you to deliver it for me?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Hiljuti sain kirja
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}-lt.

{07 0f 00}Aga unustasin täiesti oma
vastust saata. {01 01 00}{07 06 00}Oh!{01 01 00} {07 0b 00}Kas sa
viiksid selle minu eest?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Um,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}?{01 00 00 0a 00} You and I
are pretty close friends,
right?
{07 00 00}I was wondering{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Could you
take this letter to
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} for me?
{07 16 00}The post office would take
too long,{01 00 00 14 00}{07 06 00} and if they
sent it to someone else{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}!
{07 02 00}I'd be so embarrassed,{01 00 00 0a 00} my
head would probably burst
into flames,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ee,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}?{01 00 00 0a 00} Meie oleme
üsna lähedased sõbrad,
eks?
{07 00 00}Ma mõtlesin{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Kas sa
viiksid selle kirja
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}-le minu eest?
{07 16 00}Postkontor võtaks liiga
kaua,{01 00 00 14 00}{07 06 00} ja kui nad
saadaksid selle valele{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}!
{07 02 00}Mul oleks nii piinlik,{01 00 00 0a 00} et
mu pea ilmselt süttiks
põlema,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!
